title: C1 Tape Format
description: Append-only JSONL tape. Each physical line is either an `entry` (immutable fact, may carry decision rationale) or an `anchor` (phase boundary + state snapshot). Corrections happen by superseding a prior entry, never by deleting a line. `view` is a derived read-model assembled on demand from entry/anchor lines and is not itself a physical tape line; its shape is defined here under $defs/view for validating assembled output.

id.description: Opaque unique identifier for a tape line (e.g. ULID/UUID).

schema_version.description: Semver of this tape line's shape, independent of payload/event schema versions.

agent.description: Identifier of the agent/skill that wrote this line, e.g. 'agent0', 'agent1', or a specific skill id.

run_id.description: Identifier of the session/run this tape belongs to (ties to a Home directory).

seq.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number within a single tape file, used for total ordering and view assembly ranges.

entry.description: An immutable fact. Corrections are made by appending a new entry with `supersedes` pointing at the id being corrected -- the superseded entry is never deleted or mutated.

kind.description: Dotted namespace.subject.verb kind, typically aligned with a C2 event name (see c2_events.schema.json).

data.description: The immutable fact payload. Shape is kind-specific and constrained further by C2 where `kind` matches a registered event name.

rationale.description: Why this fact/decision was recorded -- required for entries that represent an agentic decision point (see house rule: everything observable).

supersedes.description: Id of a prior entry this one corrects/replaces. Absent for non-correcting entries.

refs.description: Ids of other entries this one causally depends on or references.

anchor.description: A phase boundary marker carrying a state snapshot.

phase.description: IPO phase name, e.g. Collect/Structure/Judge/Publish (agent0) or Recon/BuildProbes/Attack/Score/Report/Retest (agent1).

state.description: Snapshot of accumulated state as of this phase boundary.

prev_anchor.description: Id of the previous anchor in this run, or null for the first anchor.

tape_line.description: A single physical JSONL row on the tape.

view.description: Derived, on-demand read-model assembled from a range of tape lines with supersede resolution applied. Not persisted as a tape line; may be cached but is never authoritative -- the tape itself is authoritative.

phase.description: Phase this view was assembled for, if scoped to one.

entries.description: Entries in range with superseded entries resolved out (or annotated, depending on assembly mode).

state.description: Merged state as of the end of source_range.
